promotionCandidates.title: Disambiguate the two exported WeaponAttackResult contracts

evidence.note: The shared WeaponAttackResult is a computed rules result containing bonuses, dice, damage type, and selected ability.
The second exported WeaponAttackResult instead describes hook command state through apply, isPending, and canAttack.

promotionCandidates.problem: Two exported interfaces use the same unqualified name for unrelated concepts, so symbol search and auto-import results require path inspection to distinguish a rules computation from a React hook controller. No production consumer imports both, so the impact is navigation and maintenance ambiguity rather than a runtime defect.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Rename the client hook contract to UseWeaponAttackResult, preserving the shared computation name and aligning the client type with useWeaponAttack.
